group.title: A component-sample offer
group.passage:
Sample evaluation offer

Orion Components can provide up to eight samples of its new locking switch to qualified business customers. The samples are free, but the recipient pays shipping. To apply, send your company name, intended application, and expected annual quantity.

Samples are supplied for evaluation only and must not be installed in products sold to customers. The standard lead time for a commercial order is four weeks after order confirmation. Evaluation samples normally leave our warehouse within five business days.

A dimensional drawing and a preliminary test report are available on request. Final production specifications will be issued next month; the preliminary report should not be treated as a final specification.
group.passageZh:
樣品評估方案

Orion Components 可向符合資格的企業客戶提供最多八個新型鎖扣開關樣品。樣品免費，但運費由收件者支付。申請時請提供公司名稱、預定用途及預估年需求量。

樣品只供評估，不得安裝於販售給客戶的產品。商業訂單的標準交期為訂單確認後四週；評估樣品通常在五個工作天內離開倉庫。

可依需求提供尺寸圖及初步測試報告。正式量產規格將於下月發行；初步報告不得當成最終規格。
